purpose: Share a whole vault with another person: the model that reads who has access and turns what was typed into a grantee, and a React sheet to give access, see who has it and take it away.

library.title: Vault share sheet (give, see and remove access to a whole vault)
library.note: Share your vault with a person by their vault name or address: who has access, edit or view, inline remove. Headless ./model plus a React sheet on modal-sheet. The calls themselves are vault-access; a share of one record is lws-relations. Share access grant: the sheet for it. Also found as: share; give access; invite; who has access; owner. Takes a help line under the title, shows your own row as You, and remembers the name you typed for each person.
